declared_before: any E6 variant result was computed (only the frozen baseline n=105 reproduction and synthetic tests had run)
fit_window: 2024-09-26 -> 2026-09-25 real NQ 1-min; window A never loaded
baseline: B0 = frozen v3 mantra (mnq.signal strong + mnq.trade 2R), next-open +1 tick fill, cut 10:30
control_not_selectable: B2 = same next-open fill, trigger candle filter removed
selection_rule: highest mean R per trade among variants with n>=30, tie -> larger n; fit window only
tests: paired day-level sign-flip permutation (100000) on daily R difference vs B0, one-sided; also each variant vs 0

amendment_1.what_happened: M1 (fill allowed inside the touch bar, path convention, stop placed at the final low) was run FIRST and its 6 results were seen: best tol15/off n=245 +0.453R, paired p .0015 vs B0, but the control B2 (same setup, next-open, no trigger filter) was -0.246R. A swing that large is a look-ahead red flag.
amendment_1.diagnosis: M1 assumes the retest low is final before the cross (stop placed with knowledge of the low). Not obtainable on 1-minute bars.
amendment_1.fix_declared_before_running_it: M2 STRICT: order armed at the CLOSE of the retest bar, U = tol x that bar's range, live from the next bar, no in-bar fill on the bar that sets the stop. Same 6-variant grid, same selection rule. M2 is the primary; M1 is reported in full as an optimistic upper bound and is NOT used for selection or the prereg.
amendment_1.multiplicity_note: two models looked at, so 12 variant-looks in total; window B p<.01 (Bonferroni x5) still applies and the fit window cannot confirm anything.
